findings: Each constructed learner has serialized, sorted private return memory and begins with no accepted-return entries; parent-global return history remains unchanged by child admission.

Scheduling exposes construction-lineage ownership, while truthful physical-origin membership resolves return links formed after construction without semantic learner, depth, anatomy, target, score, episode, or evaluator routing.
An exact owner-link-generation-origin tuple is rejected, distinct later physical participation is accepted, and a retired and reused generation is fresh.
One causal moment contributes at most one recursive return admission per physical origin, preventing multiple return links from double-crediting one participation.

Fresh return memory composes with owner-aware closure identity to exact adjacent ancestry through depth three, byte-exact checkpoint replay, natural quiescence, and unchanged unrelated-return behavior.
All 25 active core tests, strict candidate checks, deterministic discovery artifacts, and the 0.22-second independent warm regression suite pass.
residual_uncertainty: The supported claim is fresh-memory recursive construction through depth three; it does not establish learner-local consequence control, action selection, recruitment, sibling isolation, body composition, or authority.
Reflection, reordered discovery, and dormant-surface scaling remain inherited candidate controls rather than separate authority runs for this mechanism.
The discovery and verification evidence supports sufficiency of the candidate mechanism, not default protocol adoption.
